verdict: Ad costs spiked this week; several planned build-outs remain overdue.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 126 leads from Meta at an average cost per lead of $6.09, but the most recent 7 days tell a different story: spend nearly doubled while leads fell 24%, pushing your cost per lead up 150% above that baseline. The likely driver is creative fatigue — one campaign has absorbed 83% of your 28-day budget, and with flat spend and falling leads, the audience has seen the same message too many times. Ad creative is being refreshed and budget concentration is being rebalanced this week. Separately, a number of build-outs that were scoped earlier this year — including search campaigns, landing pages, and lead nurture sequences — are not yet live, and getting those in place is the priority that will have the most impact on your results going forward.
